name: dsh-text-editor
description: In-app Monaco-based text-editor capability provider for the DSH Web GUI. Exposes two client-side capabilities via the 'dsh-text-editor' service (ctx.provide): openFile (open a file in a 文件 tab, editable + saveable) and showDiff (show a sequence of per-file diffs in a 差异 tab, manually advanced). Host half (index.ts) registers read/write/Monaco routes; browser half (src/client.ts → lib/client.js) registers the tabs and provides the service. No longer intercepts file-link clicks itself.

scripts.check: node --check lib/client.js && node --check index.ts && node --check host/read.ts && node --check host/write.ts && node --check host/monaco.ts && node --check host/http.ts && node --check host/types.ts
